verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to export all account data in open formats for migration. It only shows exporting issues to Jira, which is a tracker integration, and local HTML report generation via the snyk-to-html plugin. Both are adjacent features, not a full data-portability export, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
